rows.note: Use 由 as the basic source or starting-point marker, as in 由新西蘭嚟 or 由地板到天花板.

example.english: I came from New Zealand to study in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 我由新西蘭嚟香港讀書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau4 san1 sai1 laan4 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 duk6 syu1

rows.note: Use this predicate to say that one thing is different from another.

example.english: This cup of coffee is different from that one.
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 tung4 go2 bui1 m4 tung4

rows.note: Use 用 A 整 when stating the material used to make something.

example.english: This table is made from wood.
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 hai6 jung6 muk6 zing2 ge3

rows.note: Use 因為 A to give a cause or condition producing an outcome.

example.english: I have a stomachache from eating spoiled seafood.
example.traditional: 因為食咗變壞嘅海鮮，我肚痛。
example.jyutping: jan1 wai6 sik6 zo2 bin3 waai6 ge3 hoi2 sin1 ngo5 tou5 tung3
